Keeps the shared `AudioContext` running while the Remotion Studio is paused.

## CLI flag

```text
--experimental-keep-audio-context-alive
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setExperimentalKeepAudioContextAlive(true);
```
